source_refs.note: ii) Expansion of solids: a main subheading of 5.11 General properties of solids, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 109-109.

blocks.text: Expansion woh property hai jis mein particles ke darmiyan jagah barhti hai. Solids mein attractive forces itni mazboot hain ke temperature barhane se bhi particles ki jagahen mushkil se badalti hain. Solid ke particles apni mean position (ausat jagah) ke gird vibrate karte (larazte) hain. Is liye garam karne se solid ka volume bohat kam barhta hai. Solids ke linear aur cubic expansion ke coefficients hote to hain, magar liquids aur gases ke muqable mein na hone ke barabar.
bold: linear aur cubic expansion ke coefficients
